items.title: Victor Moore Interview, 1976-03-17
items.q: I haven't seen Ralph Burton in thirty years or more. ... No, I haven't [talked to Ralph Burton at all about him].

ctx.x: I've got those pictures, the pictures in football uniforms, and things like that. Mm-hmm. Mm-hmm. Uh... Maybe I could just ask you about a rehearsal of Paul... I don't know, I'll say it the way you did. Pauli Maris? Pauli Maris. Mary's. Mary's. Mary's. Mary's. Mary's. Pauli Maris. A rehearsal of his house that he had. I wasn't there. I didn't know anybody. I didn't know anybody.

Yeah. Yeah. Yeah. I didn't know anything about that. I don't know. In the first place, I wasn't with Paul Whiteman. Oh, oh, no, no. This isn't the one in New Orleans. This is supposed to be in Chicago. Oh, I doubt that. And, uh... In the first place, I think Pauli was back in New Orleans by that time. Uh... Well, probably... Ralph Burton wasn't even sure it was his house, but you... it was a jam session somewhere where Bix came in late, and, uh, several members of the Wolverines were there already. I'm reading…
don't know whether you—I don't remember them.
